context_requirements: Functional NGF/NGFR signaling in the assayed cell line
Expression of NGF or its receptors (NTRK1, NGFR/p75) at levels sufficient for autocrine or paracrine signaling
A transcriptional program dependent on NGF signaling that can be measured in the 978 landmark genes
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in multiple cell lines
Enrichment of NGF/NGFR pathway target genes among differentially expressed landmark genes
Consistent transcriptional response across cell lines known to express NGF receptors
